text: 中国人民银行10月13日对外公布，向威士信息技术（北京）有限公司下发准予行政许可决定，批准其筹备银行卡清算机构。后续，威士公司需在一年内完成筹备工作，之后可提交开业申请，中国人民银行会同金融监管总局审批同意后，颁发银行卡清算业务许可证。据介绍，威士信息技术（北京）有限公司是维萨公司在我国境内成立的企业法人，为外商投资企业。
text_en: The People's Bank of China announced on October 13 that it issued an administrative licensing decision to Visa Information Technology (Beijing) Co., Ltd., approving it to prepare a bank card clearing institution. Subsequently, Visa Inc. must complete preparatory work within one year, after which it may submit an application to commence operations. After the People's Bank of China, together with the National Financial Regulatory Administration, approves it, a bank card clearing business license will be issued. According to the introduction, Visa Information Technology (Beijing) Co., Ltd. is a corporate legal person established in China by Visa Inc. and is a foreign-invested enterprise.
